exact.Boven de ingestelde batterij-SoC mag Hom: Above the configured battery SoC, HomeFlux may deliberately keep a small continuous export. For example, 50 W means a target around -50 W. Below the SoC threshold this export buffer is fully disabled and the home battery receives the PV surplus.

exact.zonder bruikbare Homey-prijzen wordt nie: without usable Homey prices, no grid charging and no price-driven discharging take place. PV surplus capture and Peak Guard remain active.

exact.Bepaalt hoe vaak een werkelijk batterijc: Determines how often an actual battery command may change and which small setpoint changes may be ignored.
exact.Voor batterijen die bepaalde periodes ni: For batteries that cannot include certain periods in their internal charge or discharge schedule. During this window the last valid setpoint is retained.

exact.De exportbuffer en batterij-SoC-drempel: The export buffer and battery SoC threshold determine when PV limiting may start. The send interval determines how often the PV output may actually change.
exact.Minimum en maximum vormen de laadstroomg: Minimum and maximum define the charge-current limits. The standard charge current is used when Smart charging is allowed to charge through a selected tariff.
exact.Deze twee grenzen bepalen wanneer HomeFl: These two thresholds determine when HomeFlux may activate cooling or heating respectively.

exact.De boost start pas boven de ingestelde b: The boost only starts above the configured battery SoC. Start and stop margins belong together; with large grid import, EV grid charging or Peak Guard, the extra boost is removed immediately.
exact.Minimum en maximum bepalen het bereik; s: Minimum and maximum define the range; step size defines the valid intermediate values.
exact.De energiebehoefte stuurt de gewone dag-: Energy need drives normal day and night planning. exact.Voorwaartse planningsbehoefte. Overdag:: Forward planning need. During the day: need minus today’s remaining PV. After PV ends: need minus tomorrow’s PV. Current battery SoC already contains energy that was actually stored earlier today.
exact.Gewenste bruikbare reserve boven Minimum: Desired usable daytime reserve above Minimum SoC for the next peak period. Active only during the solar day and in selected months. exact.Dezelfde reserve als percentage van de t: The same reserve as a percentage of total battery capacity. Changing one field automatically updates the other. By default this reserve applies during the day; the option below can also apply it in night planning.
exact.HomeFlux gebruikt twee forecastrollen te: HomeFlux uses two forecast roles at the same time: the full-day forecast for day strategy/Battery Save, and the remaining forecast for energy planning from now. After PV ends, both use tomorrow’s forecast.

exact.De automatische HVAC-sessie start alleen: The automatic HVAC session starts only with sufficient PV surplus and outside the configured activation margin. Peak Guard, high grid import or EV grid charging can end the extra HVAC control immediately.
exact.Ook wanneer EV-netladen start of Peak Gu: The extra HVAC control also stops immediately when EV grid charging starts or Peak Guard becomes active.
exact.EV’s werken onafhankelijk en staan niet: EVs operate independently and are not part of the thermal priority list. HomeFlux starts at most one new EV per normal EMS cycle.
exact.De naam wordt in tabs en Live status get: The name is shown in tabs and Live status. EV 1 always remains visible for Flow verification.
exact.Uit = geen inputs verwacht en de EV-uitg: Off = no inputs are expected and the EV outputs are safely stopped.
exact.Uit wanneer geen voertuig-SoC beschikbaa: Disable when no vehicle SoC is available. SoC requests for this EV then stop completely.

exact.Verandert het PV-vermogen sinds het laat: If PV power changes by at least this amount since the last successfully published battery command, the next permitted control moment uses current P1 instead of the selected averaging. Intermediate calculations do not clear this PV change. The minimum time between battery commands still applies. The PV delta is never added as power and does not increase control gain. 0 = disabled.
exact.Standaard 5 min. Gewone wijzigingen word: Default 5 min. Ordinary changes are combined: the charge plan is refreshed during the slow context loop once this minimum time has elapsed. Until then, the last plan stays visible. The first usable plan, changed settings, manual refresh and a new planning day or phase may calculate immediately through the same context loop.
exact.Verandert het PV-vermogen tussen twee op: When PV power changes by at least this amount between consecutive readings, HomeFlux uses current P1 for control. The next PV change below this threshold restores the selected averaging. Without new PV data, this live selection expires after two expected measurement intervals, based on the observed input frequency (up to 10 minutes). No extra timer is used. The minimum battery command interval still applies; the next command moment uses the latest measurement state. PV delta is not added as extra power. Other enabled live options still apply independently. 0 = disabled.
exact.Schakel alleen de logging in die je nodi: Enable only the logging you need. The first enabled option starts a diagnostics session; all logging automatically switches off after at most 48 hours. EMS control, P1 cadence and planning are not sped up or slowed down by this.
exact.Logt elke echte herberekening van de ene: Logs every actual energy-planning recalculation, the relevant inputs and the associated HomeFlux settings. Settings are recorded again only when the configuration changes.
exact.Meet proces-CPU eenmaal per minuut en te: Measures process CPU once per minute and counts/times the major code paths using lightweight wall-time measurement: fast control, slow context, planning, battery publication, status publication and EMS device sync.
exact.Bewaart HomeFlux-fouten en stackinformat: Stores HomeFlux errors and stack information in a bounded buffer for the report.
exact.Meet RSS, heap, external memory en array: Measures RSS, heap, external memory and array buffers once per minute.
exact.Het rapport bevat geen API-tokens, wacht: The report contains no API tokens, passwords or other key fields. Planning does include the HomeFlux configuration needed to reproduce a decision afterwards.

Globaal voor alle EV’s. HomeFlux vormt é: Global for all EVs. HomeFlux creates one PV budget from real remaining PV surplus and PV power the home battery is already charging with. This percentage determines the share the combined EV pool may use. The EV budget is then distributed according to the individual EV weights. Normal battery control remains unchanged.
Batterij gebruiken om boiler te onderste: Use battery to support boiler during Peak Guard
Uit: de boiler wordt gestopt wanneer zij: Off: the boiler is stopped when tariff heating does not fit within Peak Guard. On: planned battery grid charging yields first and the battery may temporarily discharge to keep the essential boiler within Peak Guard. Minimum SoC, boiler stop SoC and maximum discharge limits always remain in effect.
Installeer het HomeFlux EMS-apparaat via: Install the HomeFlux EMS device through Add devices to make quick EMS adjustments without an extra Flow card. The device also shows the active override, who currently owns battery control, and the most important EV status and EV planning information.
De kost- en winstvisualisatie is beschik: The cost and savings visualization is available as a HomeFlux widget. The separate EMS status widget shows current EMS information, planning, Hybrid ownership, EV, HVAC and boiler information directly on your Homey dashboard.
